Kenya:

Distinguished Traveller

Small group  ·  Fully escorted  ·  Dietary needs accommodated

✦ ✦ ✦

Austin turns 50 on November 29th. He has finally aged into the escorted group tours he used to make fun of. This is one of those. We would very much like you to join him.

Austin's Curated Itinerary

Dates are illustrative — the itinerary is fully flexible based on the group's availability.

Days 1–2
Nov 27–28
Nairobi — Arrival & Orientation
Your representative meets you at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport. Welcome dinner at a gentle pace. No rushing.
Days 3–5
Nov 28–Dec 1
Mt. Kenya — The Highland Trek
Africa's second-highest mountain: bamboo forest, giant groundsels, glacial moorland. Trek length is customisable based on fitness level. November 29th — Austin's birthday — we raise a glass above the clouds.
Days 6–9
Dec 2–5
Lamu — The Swahili Coast
Short flight to Manda Island. No motor vehicles. Dhow excursions, empty beach, and Nyumba Kiru — a private estate with pool, chef, and 2.5km of sand entirely to yourselves.
Days 10–12
Dec 5–7
Masai Mara — Optional Safari Extension
For those who wish to remain. Bush breakfasts, open plains, elephants at close range. Children are strongly encouraged to attend.
Batian & Nelion, Mt. Kenya  ·  directly on the equator

Practical Information
Flights
Direct flights available from JFK. Thanksgiving week, plus or minus a few days, is recommended for the ideal travel window.
Physical Preparation
The Mt. Kenya trek is fully customisable based on fitness level. Guests who have completed multi-day trails are well-positioned for the full route.
Travelling with Children
Children of all ages welcomed. Childcare, dedicated accommodation, and activities available for younger travellers.
Group Size
This is an intimate journey. Nyumba Kiru accommodates up to 14 guests. A soft expression of interest is all that is needed to reserve your place.
Estimated Cost
Approximately $1,000 per person all-inclusive for Nairobi, Mt. Kenya, and Lamu. Optional Mara extension an additional ~$1,000 per person. Final costs shared once the group is confirmed.
Logistics
All itinerary, accommodation, and on-the-ground logistics are fully arranged. All you need to do is book a flight to Nairobi.
